verdict.rationale: A probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, which indicates a documented public API. A community commenter also refers to calling CodeRabbit's API to generate patches from a GitHub Action, and the official CLI offers a further scriptable surface. missing for 10: evidence of what the API actually covers (e.g. triggering reviews, reading findings, managing config), first-party prose docs on API authentication and usage, and independent hands-on confirmation of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
